summary.text: Sidney Barthelemy is a Democratic member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 3 (Orleans and St. Bernard parishes), and was elected in 2026, according to the official Senate member page.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as Morehouse College.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs, Education, Judiciary B, and Retirement, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Orleans Delegation.
